findings.name: Gradient text
findings.description: Gradient text is decorative rather than meaningful — a common AI tell, especially on headings and metrics. Use solid colors for text.

findings.name: Layout property animation
findings.description: Animating width, height, padding, or margin causes layout thrash and janky performance. Use transform and opacity instead, or grid-template-rows for height animations.

findings.name: Glowing shadow accents
findings.description: Colored glow shadows — a zero-offset chromatic halo (box- or text-shadow) on any background, or any colored blurred shadow on a dark background — are the default "cool" look of AI-generated UIs. Use neutral elevation shadows and subtle, purposeful lighting instead.

findings.detail: text-transform: uppercase on 52 chars of body text
findings.name: All-caps body text
findings.description: Long passages in uppercase are hard to read. We recognize words by shape (ascenders and descenders), which all-caps removes. Reserve uppercase for short labels and headings.

findings.name: Gray text on colored background
findings.description: Gray text looks washed out on colored backgrounds. Use a darker shade of the background color instead, or white/near-white for contrast.
